final_response:
I read this as a request for the final persistence migration contract only - below is the backward-compatible v3 design, failure policy, and test matrix.

## Recommended model

Make pane content authoritative rather than inferring content from the owning tab:

```ts
type PaneContent =
  | {
      kind: "terminal";
      sessionId: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: "browser";
      url: string;
      title?: string | null;
      profileId?: string;
      worktreePath?: string;
      worktreeLabel?: string;
    };

type TabPaneLayout = {
  root: PaneNode;
  activeLeafId: string | null;
  expandedLeafId: string | null;

  /** v3 authority: exactly one valid entry per tree leaf. */
  contentByLeafId: Record<string, PaneContent>;

  /**
   * Temporary internal compatibility projection.
   * Contains terminal leaves only and is derived from contentByLeafId.
   */
  sessionIdsByLeafId: Record<string, string>;
};
```

`sessionIdsByLeafId` should remain available during the transition because pane close, detach, move, activity lookup, PTY cleanup, and several tests currently consume it directly. All new mutations must update `contentByLeafId` first and regenerate the terminal-only projection.

Persisted browser content must not treat `browserId` as durable identity. Native browser sessions are process-local. On cold restore, create a new native browser from persisted metadata and install the returned runtime `browserId`. HMR can retain existing runtime IDs through the in-memory workspace state.

## Old v2 JSON

A terminal tab and browser tab are separate tab-level variants. Terminal pane ownership is encoded by `sessionIdsByLeafId`; browser metadata lives outside the pane tree.

```json

  "version": 2,
  "timestamp": 1787292000000,
  "activeWorkspaceId": "alpha",
  "workspaces": {
    "alpha": {
      "workspaceId": "alpha",
      "repoRoot": "/repo/alpha",
      "activeWorktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
      "worktrees": [
        {
          "path": "/repo/alpha",
          "branch": "refs/heads/main",
          "head": "abc123",
          "isMain": true,
          "isLocked": false
        }
      ],
      "layout": {
        "splitMode": "none",
        "primaryTabId": "tab-terminal",
        "secondaryTabId": null,
        "activeTabId": "tab-terminal",
        "tabs": [
          {
            "id": "tab-terminal",
            "kind": "terminal",
            "label": "Terminal",
            "terminal": {
              "primarySessionId": "session-1",
              "paneTree": {
                "type": "split",
                "direction": "horizontal",
                "ratio": 0.6,
                "first": {
                  "type": "leaf",
                  "leafId": "leaf-1"
                },
                "second": {
                  "type": "leaf",
                  "leafId": "leaf-2"
                }
              },
              "sessionIdsByLeafId": {
                "leaf-1": "session-1",
                "leaf-2": "session-2"
              },
              "activeLeafId": "leaf-2",
              "expandedLeafId": null
            }
          },
          {
            "id": "tab-browser",
            "kind": "browser",
            "label": "Docs",
            "browser": {
              "browserId": "browser-old-process-42",
              "url": "https://example.com/docs",
              "title": "Documentation",
              "loading": false,
              "canGoBack": true,
              "canGoForward": false,
              "profileId": "default",
              "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
              "worktreeLabel": "main"
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      "terminalSessions": {
        "session-1": {
          "localSessionId": "session-1",
          "backendSessionId": "pty-1",
          "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
          "cwd": "/repo/alpha",
          "createdAt": 1787292000000
        },
        "session-2": {
          "localSessionId": "session-2",
          "backendSessionId": "pty-2",
          "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
          "cwd": "/repo/alpha/packages/web",
          "createdAt": 1787292000000
        }
      }
    }
  }

```

Migration must preserve these as two tabs. It must not silently combine existing terminal and browser tabs.

## New v3 JSON

Use one pane payload for all tabs. The following shows the resulting format after a browser has intentionally been moved into a terminal tab:

```json
{
  "version": 3,
  "timestamp": 1787293000000,
  "activeWorkspaceId": "alpha",
  "workspaces": {
    "alpha": {
      "workspaceId": "alpha",
      "repoRoot": "/repo/alpha",
      "activeWorktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
      "worktrees": [
        {
          "path": "/repo/alpha",
          "branch": "refs/heads/main",
          "head": "abc123",
          "isMain": true,
          "isLocked": false
        }
      ],
      "layout": {
        "activeTabId": "tab-workspace",
        "tabs": [
          {
            "id": "tab-workspace",
            "kind": "pane",
            "label": "Workspace",
            "pinned": false,
            "pane": {
              "paneTree": {
                "type": "split",
                "direction": "horizontal",
                "ratio": 0.6,
                "first": {
                  "type": "leaf",
                  "leafId": "leaf-terminal"
                },
                "second": {
                  "type": "leaf",
                  "leafId": "leaf-browser"
                }
              },
              "contentByLeafId": {
                "leaf-terminal": {
                  "kind": "terminal",
                  "sessionId": "session-1"
                },
                "leaf-browser": {
                  "kind": "browser",
                  "url": "https://example.com/docs",
                  "title": "Documentation",
                  "profileId": "default",
                  "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
                  "worktreeLabel": "main"
                }
              },
              "activeLeafId": "leaf-browser",
              "expandedLeafId": null
            }
          }
        ],
        "tabGroups": [
          {
            "id": "group-default",
            "tabIds": ["tab-workspace"],
            "activeTabId": "tab-workspace"
          }
        ],
        "tabGroupLayout": {
          "type": "group",
          "groupId": "group-default"
        },
        "focusedGroupId": "group-default"
      },
      "terminalSessions": {
        "session-1": {
          "localSessionId": "session-1",
          "backendSessionId": "pty-1",
          "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
          "cwd": "/repo/alpha",
          "createdAt": 1787293000000
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

A migrated v2 browser tab becomes a v3 single-leaf pane tab:

```json
{
  "id": "tab-browser",
  "kind": "pane",
  "label": "Docs",
  "pane": {
    "paneTree": {
      "type": "leaf",
      "leafId": "leaf-browser:tab-browser"
    },
    "contentByLeafId": {
      "leaf-browser:tab-browser": {
        "kind": "browser",
        "url": "https://example.com/docs",
        "title": "Documentation",
        "profileId": "default",
        "worktreePath": "/repo/alpha",
        "worktreeLabel": "main"
      }
    },
    "activeLeafId": "leaf-browser:tab-browser",
    "expandedLeafId": null
  }
}
```

The old `browserId` is deliberately not written into canonical v3 browser content.

## Exact migration location

### Semantic migration

Put the authoritative migration in:

```text
ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts
```

Add a pure boundary function conceptually equivalent to:

```ts
migrateWorkspaceSession(
  input: unknown,
): MigrationResult<PersistedWorkspaceSessionV3>
```

Call it at the beginning of `deserializeWorkspaceState`, before any workspace, tab, tree, session, profile, or restore-setting logic.

The flow should be:

```text
loadSession()
  -> native envelope decoding
  -> migrateWorkspaceSession(raw)
  -> deserialize canonical v3 workspace
  -> create runtime browser instances
  -> reconcile live/dead PTYs
  -> restoreWorkspace()
```

`deserializeWorkspaceState` should consume only canonical v3 after migration. It should not continue accumulating inline `terminal ?? legacyField ?? layoutsByTabId` branches.

### Native boundary

Keep these as storage/transport boundaries, not semantic migration points:

```text
src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs
src-tauri/src/ipc/session.rs
src-tauri/src/daemon/protocol.rs
src-tauri/src/daemon/server.rs
```

Rust should:

- Decode and encode versions 1, 2, and 3.
- Preserve v3 pane fields through Tauri and daemon round trips.
- Reject unsupported envelope versions.
- Continue atomic write and corrupted-file backup behavior.
- Not decide browser profiles, terminal defaults, pane repair, or browser restore settings.

Prefer adding typed Rust v3 pane fields rather than relying indefinitely on flattened `extra` maps. `paneTree` and `contentByLeafId` may remain `serde_json::Value` because Rust does not interpret their semantics.

### Write migration

`serializeWorkspaceState` should write only version 3. Migration remains in memory until a successful normal auto-save or close-guard save. Do not immediately overwrite the old file merely because it parsed.

That preserves the original saved state if runtime browser creation or PTY restoration fails.

## v1/v2 conversion rules

For every legacy terminal tab:

1. Select the tree in this order:
   - `terminal.paneTree`
   - legacy `tab.paneTree`
   - `layout.layoutsByTabId[tabId].root`
   - generated single leaf
2. For each tree leaf, select the session ID in this order:
   - `terminal.sessionIdsByLeafId[leafId]`
   - legacy `tab.sessionIdsByLeafId[leafId]`
   - legacy layout mapping
   - `terminal.primarySessionId`
   - `tab.sessionId`
3. Emit `{ "kind": "terminal", "sessionId": id }`.
4. Preserve active and expanded leaves only if they exist in the repaired tree.

For every legacy browser tab:

1. Generate or retain a single leaf.
2. Move URL, title, profile, worktree path, and worktree label into browser pane content.
3. Discard persisted `loading`, navigation booleans, visibility, bounds, generation, webview label, and `browserId` as runtime observations.
4. On cold restore, call `createBrowser` and retain its returned `browserId`.
5. If the saved profile no longer exists, use the current default profile.

Apply the same migration independently to the active layout and every `worktreeLayouts[path]` entry.

## Invalid-state policy

Use containment and deterministic repair rather than failing the entire session for one bad pane.

### Entire file

- Invalid JSON or failure to decode the required envelope: move to `.json.corrupted`, return no session.
- Unsupported future version: return no session without labeling it corrupted or overwriting it.
- Missing requested workspace: return `null` for that workspace and preserve other workspace entries.

### Layout and pane tree

- Unknown node type or unusable root: drop that tab.
- Invalid direction: replace with `"horizontal"`.
- Non-finite ratio: use `0.5`.
- Finite ratio outside the valid range: clamp to `0.1...0.9`.
- Duplicate leaf IDs: keep the first and deterministically rename later occurrences using the tab ID and tree path.
- When renaming a duplicate legacy leaf, copy its original content mapping so data is not lost.
- Extra mappings not represented in the tree: discard them.
- Invalid `activeLeafId`: use the first surviving leaf.
- Invalid `expandedLeafId`: set it to `null`.
- Empty tab after repair: remove it.
- Empty split branch after filtering: collapse the split to its surviving branch.
- Invalid tab groups, group actives, focused group, and layout references: prune and rebuild through `normalizeLayout`.

### Terminal content

- Empty or invalid session ID: remove that leaf.
- Referenced session missing from `terminalSessions`: synthesize a dead local session with:
  - the referenced ID as local identity,
  - `backendSessionId: null`,
  - CWD from legacy tab worktree path, active worktree, or repo root,
  - lifecycle `"exited"`.
- Existing backend ID absent from the live backend list: set it to `null`; boot restore may respawn it.
- Remove terminal session records not referenced by any surviving terminal pane.

### Browser content

- Missing or invalid URL: use `"about:blank"`.
- Deleted or unknown profile: use the current default profile.
- Persisted `browserId`: ignore during cold restore.
- Native browser creation failure: retain the pane as an error/placeholder browser pane; do not drop the rest of the tab or overwrite the saved session.
- If “restore browser tabs” is disabled:
  - remove browser leaves,
  - collapse affected splits,
  - drop browser-only tabs,
  - preserve terminal leaves in mixed tabs.

### Save safety

Only save migrated v3 state when:

- At least one valid tab survives, and
- Runtime restoration has completed sufficiently to produce a coherent workspace state.

A migration yielding zero valid tabs must not replace the original saved file.

## Required tests

### Migration and serialization

| Test | Expected result |
|---|---|
| v1 flat terminal tab | Single terminal pane content created |
| v1 split tree without mapping | Every leaf receives the primary session |
| v2 terminal split | Tree, ratios, session ownership, active and expanded leaf survive |
| v2 browser tab | Single browser pane created; metadata preserved; old browser ID not canonicalized |
| v2 active plus parked worktree layouts | Every layout migrates independently |
| v3 mixed terminal/browser round trip | Exact tree and content ownership survive |
| Multi-workspace save | Updated workspace merges without changing other workspaces |
| Browser restore disabled | Browser leaves removed and mixed trees collapsed |
| Orphan terminal sessions | Omitted from saved v3 state |
| Missing referenced terminal session | Dead session synthesized and eligible for respawn |

### Invalid-state repair

| Test | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Extra content mapping keys | Extra keys removed |
| Missing leaf content | Leaf removed and parent split collapsed |
| Duplicate leaf IDs | Deterministic unique IDs with content preserved |
| Invalid active/expanded IDs | First leaf/null selected |
| NaN/infinite ratio | Ratio becomes `0.5` |
| Out-of-range ratio | Ratio clamped |
| Broken single tab | Only that tab dropped |
| Broken parked layout | Other layouts still restore |
| Unsupported version 4 | Ignored, not moved to corrupted backup |
| Malformed JSON | Moved to corrupted backup |

### Pane lifecycle

| Operation | Assertions |
|---|---|
| Close terminal pane | Remove leaf/content/projection; close PTY only if globally unreferenced |
| Close browser pane | Remove leaf/content; close native browser only |
| Close final pane | Close owning tab using content-specific cleanup |
| Move terminal pane | Session ID and PTY retained; no spawn or close |
| Move browser pane | Full browser metadata and runtime browser ID retained |
| Move mixed subtree | Every content mapping moves; collisions remapped consistently |
| Swap panes | Content remains bound to leaf identity according to the selected swap contract |
| Resize pane | Clamped ratio persists through v3 round trip |
| Detach pane to tab | New tab has one leaf and the exact original content |
| Merge tab into pane | Source tab removed; all source content appears exactly once |

### Runtime restore

| Test | Expected result |
|---|---|
| Cold terminal restore with live PTY | Existing backend ID retained |
| Cold terminal restore with dead PTY | New PTY spawned while local session and leaf IDs remain stable |
| Cold browser restore | `createBrowser` called from persisted metadata and new runtime ID installed |
| Browser restore creation failure | Placeholder remains; terminal siblings still render |
| HMR recovery | No browser or PTY recreation |
| Close guard after migration | Writes canonical v3 atomically |
| First post-migration auto-save | Writes v3 while preserving inactive workspaces |

### Native contract

- Rust loads versions 1, 2, and 3.
- Rust rejects version 0 and versions above 3.
- V3 `paneTree` and `contentByLeafId` survive disk save/load.
- V3 survives daemon request/response serialization.
- Unknown additive fields survive native load/resave where forward-compatible flattening is intended.
- Corrupted-file backup and atomic-write tests remain unchanged.
